goal: Restyle the website Welcome gate to match design option 9b (Session-log scatter) 100%, locked to one viewport height with no page scroll on desktop, tablet, and mobile, while preserving Codex/Claude Welcome-first copy behavior.

in: Rebuild ProjectGateway / Shell layout to match option 9b: black stage, scrolling session-log scatter background, top SESSION LOG bar, bottom tagline/status/rights bar, stacked red intro window + dark CODEX/CLAUDE action window.
Use Departure Mono / JetBrains Mono terminal typography and KitCode primary red (#fc0a0a / --color-brand-primary) as in 9b.
Fit the entire gate in 100dvh/100svh with overflow hidden and no page scroll on mobile, tablet, and desktop; scale type/spacing and optionally contentScale for short viewports.
Keep existing assistantSetupPromptFor Codex/Claude clipboard copy and connection/status wiring.
Remove non-9b gate chrome: feature icons, humans/agents guidance block, OR divider, watch-video row, current GitHub footer chrome.
Update focused project-gateway checks for the new copy and structure.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for scatter scroll animation.
out: No live telemetry wiring into session-log scatter.
No dashboard, admin, registration, Mini, Pet, or native Welcome window redesign.
No change to reward, tracker, or local-state schemas.
No new setup flows beyond the two copy CTAs.

acceptance_criteria.summary: Gate matches 9b composition: session-log scatter bg, KITCODE SESSION LOG top bar, red Introducing/KitCode. window, dark CODEX/CLAUDE window, bottom tagline/status/ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.
Gate page uses a single viewport height with overflow hidden and no document scroll on mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
CODEX and CLAUDE actions still copy assistantSetupPromptFor('codex'|'claude') Welcome-first prompts; status still reflects copy/connect state.
Reuse existing ProjectGateway surface, --color-brand-primary / --font-mono tokens, and JetBrains Mono; add Departure Mono only if required for 9b fidelity; do not fork a second gate app.
check-project-gateway.mjs asserts 9b structure/copy markers and retained Codex/Claude prompt wiring without legacy Hello/humans guidance assertions.

coverage_plan.summary: Assert 9b composition markers, no-scroll shell classes, and Codex/Claude prompt wiring.

risks.summary: Desktop 9b typography can overflow short phone landscape heights.
risks.mitigation: Fluid type/spacing plus existing contentScale fallback; overflow hidden on page shell.

risks.summary: Current check-project-gateway asserts Hello/humans copy that 9b removes.
Current GatewayAsciiCanvas is cursor-field, not session-log scatter.
risks.mitigation: Replace or adapt background to 9b scatter tracks; keep pointer-events none.

implementation_handoff.summary: Restyle apps/web ProjectGateway to option 9b session-log scatter composition with viewport-locked no-scroll layout; preserve copy prompts; update gateway check.
design_system_refs: Reuse ProjectGateway Shell / copy handlers; redesign DOM to 9b windows and bars.
Reference design source: Downloads/ASCII terminal style variations/KitCode.dc.html option #9b Session-log scatter.
Add Departure Mono only if JetBrains Mono alone cannot match 9b wordmark fidelity.
suggested_sequence: Rewrite gateway shell markup to 9b bars + two windows.
Replace ASCII background with session-log scatter animation.
Lock viewport height and responsive downscale without scroll.
